verdict.rationale: The docs show LocalAI runs a broad range of models from one runtime. It covers LLMs via GGUF models pulled from Hugging Face and Ollama, plus a built-in gallery for installing models. It also handles multi-modal workloads across text, voice, vision, images, video and 3D. Missing for 10: any evidence of 'hundreds' of architectures, explicit MoE support, explicit embedding model support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of model breadth.
